Title: Initiate the personnel action (SF-52 / RPA)
LocalProcedure: DON OCHR RPA Handling Procedures; DCPDS RPA entry
Notes: Supervisor requests; HR reviews. DON procedure governs routing, not the rule.

Title: Classify the action and assign the NOAC / legal authority
Notes: NOAC and authority are OPM-defined; DCPDS is the entry system.

Title: Approve and effect the SF-50
LocalProcedure: DCPDS UM; DON OCHR effecting procedures
Notes: HR owns through effecting the SF-50.

Title: Record benefits elections (retirement, FEHB, TSP)
LocalProcedure: DCPDS / employee self-service; flows to DCPS deduction codes
Notes: Elections are statutory/CFR; systems record them.

Title: Transmit effected personnel data DCPDS -> DCPS
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8 (payroll data source of record)
LocalProcedure: DCPS Interface Spec (Personnel Interface); nightly file
Notes: The interface is the HR->Pay ownership boundary.

Title: Record time and attendance
GoverningAuthority: 5 CFR Part 550 / Part 610 (hours of work, premium pay)

Title: Certify time and attendance
Notes: Certifier attests to correctness before pay computes.

Title: Compute gross pay, locality, and premiums
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 3; 5 CFR Part 550
Notes: DCPS computes from the updated Master Employee Record.

Title: Apply deductions in order of precedence and pay caps
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 4 (order of precedence); 5 U.S.C. 5307 (caps)
Notes: Precedence and caps are FMR/statute; DCPS enforces.

Title: Run the pre-pay audit before certification
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 5 (pay certification controls)
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec F Ch. 5 Report P6634 (Pre-Pay Audit — Gross to Deductions)
Notes: Report P6634 flags pre-pay exceptions for CSR review.

Title: Certify the payroll for payment
GoverningAuthority: 31 U.S.C. 3528 (certifying officer liability); DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 5
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec F Ch. 5 (Pay Certification)
Notes: Certifying officer is personally accountable for the certification.

Title: Disburse net pay to the employee
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 5 (disbursing); 31 U.S.C. (disbursing authority)
Notes: Net pay and allotments paid via Treasury/EFT.

Title: Reconcile gross pay and labor to accounting
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec F Ch. 7 Report P6698 (Gross Pay Reconciliation)
Notes: Report P6698 reconciles gross pay to the accounting/labor system.

Title: Correct pay via manual pay adjustment
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec D Ch. 5 (Automated/Manual Pay Adjustments)
Notes: Used when DCPS cannot auto-compute the correction.

Title: Establish and collect a pay debt (overpayment)
GoverningAuthority: DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 9 (over/underpayments and debt)
Notes: Due-process notice, waiver rights, and withholding limits apply.

Title: Confirm the action effected (SF-50 posted)
GoverningAuthority: OPM GPPA (SF-50 is the record of the action)
LocalProcedure: DCPDS / HR Link (HR); MyBiz (employee self-service view only)
Notes: MyBiz is view-only; HR verifies in DCPDS/HR Link.

Title: Establish overseas allowance entitlement (LQA/TQSA/COLA)
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec D Ch. 5 screen P1128 (Overseas Allowances)
Notes: DSSR sets the rules/max; DCPS records and pays.

Title: Reconcile LQA annually against actual expenses
GoverningAuthority: DSSR Section 130 (LQA); DoD FMR Vol 8, Ch. 9 (resulting debt)
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec D Ch. 5 (reconciliation payment type R)
Notes: Overpaid LQA becomes a collectible debt.

Title: Administer foreign-national (local-national) pay
LocalProcedure: DCPS UM Sec D Ch. 4 (Foreign-National Gross Pay)
Notes: LN pay follows prevailing-wage plans, not the GS schedule.
